catalog.name: Cinder Cull
catalog.text: The ashwoods breed vermin faster than we can burn them. Cull three.
catalog.rewardText: 13 Ember Imp stacks (+13% damage) and 13 GV

catalog.name: Break the Chains
catalog.text: Three convicts walk free who shouldn't. Remind them what chains are for.
catalog.rewardText: 13 Inquisitor stacks (+13% damage) and 13 GV

catalog.name: Plague Purge
catalog.text: The rats carry it further every night. Three fewer carriers, please.
catalog.rewardText: 13 Plague Rat stacks (+13% attack speed) and 13 GV

catalog.name: Thaw the Watch
catalog.text: Rimeguards on the far ridge, three of them. End their watch.
catalog.rewardText: 14 Ice Golem stacks (+14% max health) and 14 GV

catalog.name: Worth the Walk
catalog.text: Any elite, anywhere. Prove you can bring down something that fights back.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Flame Caller stacks (+10 Soul Offence) and 9 GV

catalog.name: A Head for a Head
catalog.text: One of your fellow champions. Any of them. I don't deal in specifics.
catalog.rewardText: 12 Inquisitor stacks (+12% damage) and 6 GV

catalog.name: The Grand Tour
catalog.text: Blood on your blade in three different lands. Bring me the itinerary.
catalog.rewardText: 16 Cinder Hound stacks (+8% move speed) and 16 GV

catalog.name: Blight Blooms
catalog.text: Pale blooms grow where the rats nest. Three, stems and all.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Plague Rat stacks (+10% attack speed) and 10 GV

catalog.name: Shards of the Watch
catalog.text: Rimeshard splinters litter the far camp. Three will reforge nicely.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Rime Stalker stacks (+12.5 Defense) and 10 GV

catalog.name: Ashcaps
catalog.text: Ashcap mushrooms, the big grey ones, from the ember camp. Three. Don't ask what for.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Ember Imp stacks (+10% damage) and 10 GV

catalog.name: Loose Links
catalog.text: Broken links from the chain camp, three of them. Evidence, you understand.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Bailiff stacks (+12.5 Defense) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Tithe
catalog.text: Blood tokens the imps hoard at their camp. Three, for the collection plate.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Acolyte stacks (+2.5% lifesteal) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Quartermaster's Cache
catalog.text: I scattered supply stubs around the middle camps. Four of them buy you my gratitude.
catalog.rewardText: 12 Plague Rat stacks (+12% attack speed) and 13 GV

catalog.name: Offerings at the Edge
catalog.text: Five shrines by the outer starts, an offering at each. The long way round is the point.
catalog.rewardText: 15 Ice Golem stacks (+15% max health) and 15 GV

catalog.name: The Ember Banner
catalog.text: My banner stands in the ashlands. Carry it back and mind the carrier's curse: everyone sees you.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Cinder Hound stacks (+5% move speed) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Frozen Standard
catalog.text: A standard lost on the glacier. Bring it home and I'll sing of you.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Ice Golem stacks (+10% max health) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Physician's Satchel
catalog.text: My satchel, left behind in the sicklands. Fetch it and try not to touch anything.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Plague Rat stacks (+10% attack speed) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Warden's Seal
catalog.text: The old seal lies in the prison yards. Bureaucracy demands its return.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Inquisitor stacks (+10% damage) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Reliquary
catalog.text: A reliquary abandoned at the blood shrine. Handle with reverence. And haste.
catalog.rewardText: 10 Acolyte stacks (+2.5% lifesteal) and 10 GV

catalog.name: The Long Haul
catalog.text: One parcel, the whole way across. Nobody who matters will carry it. Will you?
catalog.rewardText: 15 Plague Rat stacks (+15% attack speed) and 15 GV
